type: May exam-prep handoff checklist for safe single-user pre-production pilot
intended_user: One upcoming CMA test-taker (simulated or real, at operator discretion)

may_state_at_handoff.pilot_mode: Off by default — must be explicitly enabled
may_state_at_handoff.privacy_masking: Active (S117) — all synthetic student names masked
may_state_at_handoff.exam_prediction_guard: Active — no pass/fail predictions, no guaranteed-to-pass language
may_state_at_handoff.synthetic_students: 8 pre-loaded with seeded history for simulated testing

exam_discovery.rule: May should ask about exam schedule, not infer it
exam_discovery.behavior: S117 onboarding flow: after student selection, May asks 'Do you have an exam scheduled?' — Yes → asks Part (1/2/Both), then date/window. No → asks if planning, stores target window.
exam_discovery.privacy: Exam date is stored in localStorage only. No external transmission.
exam_discovery.do_not: Do not access email, calendar, or external records. Do not infer exam dates or deadlines.

encouragement_rules.positive_trend: When improvement evidence exists (delta >= 15, >= 4 attempts), May highlights learning momentum: e.g., 'Your accuracy in Section A has improved from 62% to 78% over your last 4 sessions.'
encouragement_rules.framing: All messages should frame gaps as learning opportunities, never as failures.
encouragement_rules.do_not: Never use 'exam ready,' 'guaranteed to pass,' 'will pass,' or any pass/fail prediction language.

practical_goals.rule: Suggest concrete, achievable next actions based on actual performance data
examples: Focus on 10 Cost Management questions this session — your accuracy there is 58%
Review the variance analysis concept — you've missed it in 3 of 4 attempts
Try a full 30-minute case study to build integrated reasoning stamina

privacy_rules.data_storage: All learner data stored in localStorage only. No server upload, no cloud sync, no external API calls.
privacy_rules.student_names: Masked after selection — only shown when actively selected. Privacy masking active per S117.
privacy_rules.do_not: Do not enter real names, email addresses, phone numbers, or identifying information into the app unless explicitly authorized in a later pilot session.

active_guards: S113 evidence thresholds — insights only with sufficient data
S112 recommendation gates — only Certified QIDs
S108 guarded tutoring — no banned phrases
Hallucination detection — exam prediction, answer leakage, fabricated statistics blocked
no_prediction_rules.do_not: Never predict pass/fail. Never guarantee readiness. Never create alarm or pressure. Never say 'you are exam-ready' or 'you need X more weeks.'

broad_rollout.do_not: Do not enable broad rollout. Do not add external telemetry endpoints. Do not connect to real LMS or SCORM endpoints without explicit authorization.

recommended_restart_flow.step_2: Open May panel — May will greet and ask if you're a returning student
recommended_restart_flow.step_3: Select 'Yes' — choose a synthetic student from the roll (masked names)
recommended_restart_flow.step_4: May asks about exam schedule — answer as appropriate for the test-taker
recommended_restart_flow.step_5: May provides evidence-backed insights based on seeded or accumulated history
recommended_restart_flow.step_6: Use May for practice: ask for explanations, hints, similar questions, or progress summaries
recommended_restart_flow.step_7: May's recommendations, hints, and explanations are all guarded: no exam predictions, only Certified QIDs, no answer leakage in exam mode

restart_session_recommendation: S119 — May single-user pre-production pilot readiness review. Confirm all May guards, thresholds, and gates are operational. Simulated students can be used as-is or new synthetic profiles created.
